note: A longhand now wins over a shorthand that covers it, as StyleX's property-specificity policy and atomic CSS expect: rules of one selector and breakpoint were sorted by property name, so `border-width` came after `border-top-width` and `place-items` after `align-items` and the shorthand won. Each property now sorts right after the last shorthand covering it (`all` first); unrelated properties keep their alphabetical order. This applies to every path that writes the sheet: StyleX, Box props, css(), styled and the compat APIs. No new build errors
